subject: Solaris Marketplace - joint SI integration workshop / availability poll
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@solarismarketplace.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: partners@solarismarketplace.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Joint SI + Redwood technical workshop - proposed scope and dates

Hi Tessa and Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the Solaris product team is excited about the Redwood runtime. We'd like to lock in a 3-hour joint solution workshop with our SI and marketplace integration teams to cover end-to-end architecture, deployment patterns for private deployments, and a short hands-on pattern for the catalog integration.

Proposed objectives:
- Architecture review: network/topology, auth (KMS/HSM), and data flow for marketplace installs
- Integration touchpoints: model catalog API, webhook flows, billing metering hooks
- Compatibility checklist: quantization/ops expectations and kernel behavior for our fleet
- Next steps: mutual action plan and pilot scope

Proposed dates (PST):
- Tue Nov 17, 10:00–13:00
- Wed Nov 18, 09:00–12:00
- Fri Nov 20, 11:00–14:00

Attendees (initial): Elena Park (PM, Solaris), Jain Patel (Lead infra), Solaris DevOps (eng@solarismarketplace.com). Can you confirm Redwood leads and whether you can host a dial-in? I've attached a draft agenda and a short ask list.

Attachments: solaris-proposed-agenda.pdf (PDF)

Thanks,
Elena Park
Partnerships Lead | Solaris Marketplace
elena@solarismarketplace.com

From: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
To: Elena Park <elena@solarismarketplace.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 16:18:00 -0800

Elena — thanks for the clear objectives and the agenda. We're enthusiastic to move forward. Internal leads: Marissa (Solutions), Sergio (Platform / runtime). I can host the call from Redwood's side (Zoom + shared Miro).

Quick availability check: Nov 17 and Nov 20 look promising for our senior infra folks; Nov 18 is a bit tight due to an internal all-hands. Would you mind filling out a quick availability poll so we can lock a single slot? Here's a Doodle we set up: https://doodle.com/poll/abcd1234.

Also, can you flag any compliance artifacts we should surface ahead of time (SOC 2, data residency)? We can attach a short SOC 2 evidence package if that helps.

Proposed Redwood agenda additions:
- 20m: runtime performance profiling and quantization notes (Sergio)
- 30m: dedicated capacity / scaling patterns (Marissa)
- 40m: catalog integration API walkthrough (Tessa)

I'll attach a capacity ops workbook to help with attendee prep.

Attachments: redwood-capacity-ops.xlsx (XLSX)

Best,

- Marissa Cole (me): solution patterns & Marketplace onboarding flow
- Sergio Alvarez: runtime/kernel optimizations and KV cache implications
- Dev engineer (TBD): will join for the hands-on portion

Our preference is Fri Nov 20, 11:00–14:00 PST because it gives our eng lead time to prep. If we do 3 hours, we suggest splitting as:
- Hour 1: Architecture & security (network, KMS, VPC peering)
- Hour 2: Catalog API & integration patterns (hands-on)
- Hour 3: Performance profiling + rollout plan
